import os
tot=0; n=0
for root,d,files in os.walk('.'):
    n += len(d)
    for f in files:
        p=os.path.join(root,f)
        assert not os.path.islink(p)
        tot+=os.path.getsize(p); n+=1
print('total bytes', tot, 'entries', n)" && ls -la
